name: Return of the Ring
summary: A ring from Gnomeregan bears Orgrimmar's seal and the letters NOG. Its trail leads to Nogg, a goblin engineer with a theory about the ruins.

sections.title: A Curious Discovery
sections.body: You clean a ring from Gnomeregan in the Sparklematic 5200. The machine strips away the filth and reveals Orgrimmar's official seal, a surge of magical power, and the partly legible letters NOG. Gnomeregan lies deep in Khaz Modan, an Alliance city far from the Horde capital. The ring may have been made in Kalimdor or carried there on a doomed expedition, but its seal points back to Orgrimmar.

sections.title: Gnomish Rivalries and Dark Iron Plots
sections.body: You take the ring to Nogg in Orgrimmar's Valley of Honor. The goblin engineer says it is not his, though its origins raise questions. Goblins have long regarded gnomish inventors as eccentric rivals. Nogg suspects the gnomes stole and altered Dark Iron golem designs. Since Dark Iron dwarves held the ring inside Gnomeregan, he thinks they may be seeking payback, a lead worth investigating.

faq.q: Why does a ring found in Gnomeregan bear the seal of Orgrimmar?
aliases: how did the ring get there
faq.answer: No one knows exactly how the ring reached Gnomeregan. Dark Iron dwarves carried it deep into the ruins, where it was recovered. Its Orgrimmar seal links it to Horde metalworkers and craftsmen in Durotar.
Nogg is a goblin engineer in Orgrimmar's Valley of Honor. He oversees engineering supplies and machines, and his name matches the worn letters on the cleaned ring.
The Sparklematic 5200 is an automated industrial wash system in Gnomeregan's Clean Zone. It strips heavy layers of toxic sludge and irradiation from objects brought out of the ruined corridors.
No. Nogg inspects the cleaned ring and says it is not his. He recognizes its craftsmanship and uses his engineering skill to modify it further for you.

faq.q: What does Nogg think happened to Gnomeregan?
faq.answer: Nogg suspects the gnomes stole advanced golem blueprints from the Dark Iron clan. He thinks the Dark Irons would want payback and considers the lead worth investigating.

faq.q: Can I keep the ring instead of returning it to Nogg?
aliases: do i have to give it to nogg
faq.answer: You can wear the ring at once or take it to Orgrimmar. Bringing it to Nogg lets the goblin engineer inspect its craftsmanship and offer further improvements.

angles.text: As a member of the Horde, you rarely find its symbols deep inside the Eastern Kingdoms' leading center of technology. The ring draws you from Khaz Modan to the Valley of Honor.
As an engineer, you know goblin inventors in Orgrimmar measure themselves against gnomish invention. Nogg is eager to examine anything recovered from their ruined technological wonder.
